skill.name: git-push
skill.description: Push local projects to GitHub with guided checks for large files, .gitignore updates, repository setup, daily pushes, and releases.
skill.summary: Guides safe GitHub pushes, repository setup, and release publishing for local projects.
skill.author: yunshu0909

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting false positives, including the sensitive-file and entropy alerts. Several git and GitHub CLI workflows are confirmed because they can publish local files, mutate repository history, or upload release assets. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed skill file.

remediation.issue: External git and gh commands can modify repositories and publish local data.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact command, target account, repository, and visibility before any create, add, commit, push, or release upload step.

remediation.issue: Force push and local history deletion can cause irreversible data loss.
remediation.suggestion: Keep these paths opt-in, require a second confirmation with the target name, and recommend a backup before execution.

remediation.issue: Public repositories and release assets can expose secrets or private files.
remediation.suggestion: Block common secret files by default for public publication and require explicit approval for every release attachment path.

remediation.issue: User-selected repository names, descriptions, versions, and paths are interpolated into CLI commands.
remediation.suggestion: Validate inputs and pass command arguments as structured arguments rather than building shell strings.

static_findings.snippet: - ❌ → 提示:`brew install git`,终止
- ❌ → 提示:`brew install gh`,终止
- 执行 `gh auth status` 检查
- ❌ 未登录 → 提示:`gh auth login`,终止
- 执行 `git config user.name` 和 `git config user.email` 检查
> **⚠️ 铁律:.gitignore 必须在第一次 `git add` 之前就位。绝不能先提交再排除——Git 历史里的大文件删不干净,会导致仓库臃肿、推送失败。**
用 `du -sh` 扫描所有顶级目录和文件,按大小排序。
- `.env` / `.env.*` — 环境变量/密钥
- `*secret*` / `*credential*` / `*token*` — 密钥文件
- `*.pem` / `*.key` — 证书文件
- `memory/` / `MEMORY.md` — AI 工具记忆文件
```gitignore
- 执行 `gh repo view [账号]/[仓库名]` 检查
| `rejected (fetch first)` 或 `non-fast-forward` | 远程有本地没有的提交 | 默认执行 `git pull --rebase` 后重试 |
| 仍然失败 / 远程有冲突 | 历史不兼容 | 问用户"是否强制覆盖远程?" ⚠️ 告知:"这将覆盖远程所有内容,仅在确认远程内容可以丢弃时使用"→ `git push --force` |
| 认证失败 | token 过期 | 提示 `gh auth login` |
| `file exceeds 100MB` | 单文件超限 | 提示具体文件名,加入 .gitignore,重新提交推送 |
| `git add` 或 `git commit` 失败 | 文件异常/配置缺失 | 显示错误信息,引导用户排查 |
- 自动读取自上个 tag 以来的 commit 记录(`git log [上个tag]..HEAD --oneline`)
.gitignore 在第一次 `git add` 之前就位。大文件一旦进入 Git 历史,即使后来删除,仓库体积也不会缩小,会导致推送失败或极慢。已有 git 但未关联远程的项目,也要先扫描再推送。
- `.env` / `.env.*` — 环境变量/密钥
- `*.pem` / `*.key` — 证书文件

content.value_statement: Publishing a local project can expose secrets or fail because of large files. This skill guides GitHub setup, push, and release steps with checks and confirmations.
actual_capabilities: Checks git, GitHub CLI, GitHub login, and git user configuration before pushing.
Chooses first push, daily update, or release workflow from the local repository state.
Reviews large files and sensitive filename patterns before public repository publishing.
Generates or merges .gitignore entries after showing changes for user confirmation.
Creates or links GitHub repositories, commits changes, pushes branches, and publishes tags.
Creates GitHub Releases with generated notes and optional user-approved attachments.
limitations: Requires git and the GitHub CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Uses filename and path checks for sensitive content, not full secret detection.
Cannot clean files that are already committed to Git history without extra history rewrite steps.
Operates on the current local project and the active GitHub CLI account.

use_cases.title: Publish a New Project
use_cases.description: Create a GitHub repository, prepare .gitignore, make the first commit, and push the main branch.

use_cases.title: Push Daily Updates
use_cases.description: Review changed files, check new large files, create a clear commit, and push to the existing remote.

use_cases.title: Create a GitHub Release
use_cases.description: Suggest a version tag, summarize commits, create a release, and attach approved files.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a New Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Push this project to GitHub as a private repository. Use the current folder name unless I choose another name.

prompt_templates.title: Push Current Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Push my current changes to the existing remote. Check new large files and generate a clear commit message.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Public Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish this project as a public GitHub repository. First review .gitignore, large files, and sensitive filenames with me.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Release With Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the next GitHub Release from the latest commits. Suggest a version, generate notes, and ask before uploading any asset.

output_examples.input: Push this new project to GitHub as private.
output_examples.output: The skill reports environment checks, shows proposed exclusions, creates a private repository, and confirms the first push.
The skill summarizes changed files, warns about any new large files, creates a concise commit, and confirms the push result.

output_examples.input: Create a release with the build archive.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests a version, drafts release notes from commits, asks before upload, and reports the release URL.

best_practices: Review the .gitignore changes and exclusion list before the first commit.
Use private visibility until sensitive content review is complete.
Confirm the target GitHub account, repository name, and release assets before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a public repository before checking for secrets and private files.
Do not force push unless the remote history can be safely discarded.
Do not upload release attachments that you have not reviewed.

faq.question: What tools does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires git and the GitHub CLI. The GitHub CLI must be logged in before repository operations.

faq.question: Can it create a new GitHub repository?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a new repository or link the current project to an existing repository.

faq.question: Does it prevent secrets from being published?
faq.answer: It checks sensitive filename patterns and asks for confirmation. It is not a full secret scanner.

faq.question: How does it handle large files?
faq.answer: It warns about files over 10 MB and blocks single files over the GitHub 100 MB limit.

faq.question: Can it publish public repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It adds extra review steps before public publication and asks for explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Can it create GitHub Releases?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest a version, create a tag, draft notes, and upload approved attachments.
